development_evaluation.use: frozen development evaluation, not blind confirmation

relevant_objects.mask: union every native type-5 geom segmentation pixel belonging to each selected object

natural_image_contract.global_feature: same frozen natural-image visual_projection plus L2 normalization [512]
natural_image_contract.patch_feature: same natural image last_hidden_state[:,1:] -> post_layernorm -> visual_projection -> per-token L2 normalization [49,512]

image_space_targets.coordinate_normalization: u/image_width and v/image_height; projected EE remains floating and unclipped
image_space_targets.object_aggregation: retain both runtime obj_of_interest slots and use calibration-frozen maximum across valid object-wise scalar magnitudes
image_space_targets.invisible_object_rule: visibility=0; area and mask metrics remain defined; centroid and relative targets are invalid and never imputed
image_space_targets.ee_image_displacement: L2 norm of candidate-pair projected EE coordinate difference
image_space_targets.object_centroid_displacement: maximum normalized image centroid displacement among objects visible in both candidates
image_space_targets.object_mask_difference: maximum full-image symmetric-difference fraction among per-object natural semantic masks; object-wise 1-IoU retained diagnostically
image_space_targets.relative_image_displacement: maximum norm of pair difference in (object centroid - projected EE)
image_space_targets.ee_object_distance_change: maximum absolute change in object-centroid to projected-EE distance
image_space_targets.strict_proximity_change: maximum absolute change in projected-EE to natural object-mask distance divided by image diagonal
image_space_targets.robot_object_adjacency_change: maximum absolute change in fraction of object-boundary pixels within frozen square dilation radius of natural robot mask

representations.global_10d: exact frozen global_summary from natural-spatial audit
representations.patch_10d: exact frozen patch_summary from natural-spatial audit; dimensions and broad interaction component unchanged
representations.strict_interaction_secondary: one scalar: natural patch distance weighted by relevant-object fractional coverage and a frozen 16-pixel Gaussian around projected EE
representations.signed_pca16: exact frozen calibration-fit global and patch PCA16; secondary only

probes.model: independent closed-form ridge regression with intercept
probes.selection: leave-one-init-state-out CV within init31-34; minimum mean RMSE; exact tie favors larger alpha

gates.increment_ci_rule: G+P versus G relative RMSE improvement CI lower > 0

gates.semantic_label_rule: object/relative labels additionally require relevant-patch shuffle; interaction label requires strict-interaction shuffle
